title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications and LangChain Mitigations
summary: Jeff Linwood walks through the new OWASP Top 10 for agentic applications and how to mitigate the risks.
learn: OWASP published its Top 10 for Agentic Applications the month before; the PDF pairs each risk with prevention and mitigation guidance.
Agent security has different failure modes than web security because of tool use, elevated access, long-running memory and autonomy.
The ten risks group into goal and instruction control, tools and execution, identity and privilege abuse, inter-agent communication and systemic risk such as supply chain and cascading failures.

Mitigations he covers: structure prompts and keep retrieved content out of instructions, narrow tool scope, separate agent roles in a graph with a human in the loop, and use LangSmith for observability.
The demo shows human-agent trust exploitation: an approval prompt calls a change safe while it actually drops a Kubernetes cluster, then a mitigated version adds confirmation.
